assets.prompt:
Edit only the LEGS in BOTH frames of this transparent sprite. Keep all character and computer artwork, sizes, keyboard, CRT, tower, colors, transparency and two-frame layout exactly unchanged.
The legs are far too wide. Bring the feet dramatically CLOSER TOGETHER, toward the keyboard. The knees point forward at the computer. Her legs must NOT extend horizontally toward the left and right borders. Rotate both legs inward substantially. Left sandal should appear just below the LEFT end of the keyboard, right sandal just below the RIGHT end of the keyboard. Feet should be separated by only the width of the keyboard, about HALF their current separation. Legs go from hips upward toward those sandals in a forward V. BOTH sandals must remain visible: left sandal peeking past the left side of her hair/wing, right sandal next to the keyboard's right corner. Total leg opening is approximately 70 degrees. Do not hide or omit a leg. Keep both frames identically posed except the existing small typing hand movement. Preserve the CRT desktop and complete transparent sprite sheet.

assets.prompt: Create a single transparent PNG production-ready sprite of the exact Hora character in the reference. Preserve navy bob with gold feather tips, large turquoise eyes, ivory Egyptian tunic, gold collar and bracelets, tiny folded navy-gold wings, sandals, and the thin Horus-eye ahoge with a separate floating blue jewel inside. No crown. Full body chibi girl, three-quarter profile facing RIGHT, positioned in lower-left of square canvas, leaning back LEFT with knees bent and feet braced, both hands holding a long slender GOLD SHEPHERD'S CROOK diagonally from lower-left to upper-right, as if pulling a page corner down and left. Hook end at the top RIGHT of canvas, around 88 percent x and 12 percent y; large smooth crook opens downward-left so it can hook paper. Her hands midway along shaft, body in lower left. All of staff and feet visible, generous transparent margin. Friendly determined expression, cute polished anime style and cel shading matched to reference. This will be animated as a web page-turn helper; no paper, no computer, no background, no text, no floor, no shadow. The gold staff reaches far above her toward top-right. Exact character identity is essential.

Create a transparent PNG asset of Hora for a website introduction card, using the reference for exact identity and style. A MUCH LARGER HEAD portrait, DIRECTLY FRONT FACING, perfectly upright, looking straight at the viewer with both bright turquoise eyes level, friendly curious expression. Navy bob with gold feather tips, navy Horus-eye hair curl with independent floating cyan orb, no crown. Clean detailed chibi anime shading matching reference.

Hora is peeking OVER an invisible horizontal card edge and gripping that edge with BOTH HANDS. Composition: square canvas. Hair curl near top, full oversized head centered, upper face and eyes visible, lower face hidden BEHIND the invisible card edge. Card edge crosses horizontally at 82% of image height, just below her eyes/nose; both hands at x=22% and x=78%, resting on that exact horizontal line, fingers visibly curled DOWN over the near side of the invisible edge, showing cute knuckles and fingertips. Include small gold wrist cuffs. Fingers extend down to about 92% height. No board or card painted in: all empty area and area between hands below the face must be transparent, so the website's real card will appear underneath. Only head, tiny forearms, hands; no torso, legs or wings. Face stays front-facing, no tilted head or 3/4 angle. Plenty of transparent margin. No words, shadows, background, labels or frame. Actual alpha transparency. Keep the two gripping hands clearly separate from hair.

assets.prompt:
Create a production ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET of Hora, this exact chibi girl, performing ONE continuous action: taking out a golden crook staff, raising it, going on tiptoes and reaching to hook an upper-right paper corner. Image 1 is the character identity. Image 2 is the staff design and final pull pose reference.

EXACT layout: TWELVE equal SQUARE CELLS, a grid of FOUR COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, read left to right then top to bottom. Canvas aspect 4:3. Each cell contains one full-body Hora, same scale, SAME camera and consistent position, ample transparent margins. Do not draw any grid lines, numbers, labels, paper, background, shadow or floor. Real transparent alpha. Clean anime sprite art, readable at 250px. Maintain navy bob, gold feather tips, separate cyan jewel floating inside thin Horus-eye ahoge, Egyptian ivory dress, gold details, sandals, small navy-gold wings.

Animation across the twelve cells, gradual changes each frame, not separate unrelated poses:
1. Hora stands in lower-left area facing upper right, heels down, right hand reaching behind her back, staff mostly hidden behind her.
2. Crook starts sliding out from behind her shoulder, hands bring it forward.
3. Staff now in both hands at waist height angled low.
4. She raises the crook diagonally, elbows bent.
5. Crook rising, elbows opening, eyes looking up toward hook.
6. Arms extending upward, heels beginning to lift.
7. Standing taller on toes, staff almost reaches high upper right.
8. Fully on TIPTOES, heels clearly raised, arms stretched above her toward upper right.
9. Tiny extra reach, crook catches the target at x=90%, y=17% of cell.
10. Both hands tighten, she starts leaning back while hook remains at same x=90%, y=17%.
11. She leans farther back/down-left with knees slightly bent, ready to pull.
12. Final braced pull pose similar to image 2, hook at x=90%, y=17%, girl lower left.

Critical: the character must not jump around or change size; feet baseline initially around 92% height, rising slightly on tiptoes in middle frames. Head size and outfit identical. Staff is one continuous golden crook with navy bands, hands actually grip it, hook never clipped. All twelve frames have transparent backgrounds and fully contained objects. Leave enough blank space in earlier cells for the staff to rise into; never enlarge the early poses to fill that space. This will play sequentially at 10 frames per second and then move together with a website page curl.
assets.layout: 4 columns x 3 rows, twelve sequential poses; 1320ms to reach and brace, then existing 780ms page turn.
